faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Project Officer (Technical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Project Officer (Technical) position at IIT Kharagpur is 26th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Officer (Technical) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech in ECE/EE or equivalent with at least 55% marks and 4 years of experience, or an M.Tech in ECE/EE or equivalent with at least 55% marks and 2 years of experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Officer (Technical) post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PH candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Officer (Technical) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month, which may vary based on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Officer (Technical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Officer (Technical) position at IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial application screening followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online for the Project Officer (Technical) position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Officer (Technical) position is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Kharagpur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur is located in Kharagpur, West Bengal.
